recipe.visualDefinition: A full-body portrait of two men in modern country-rock attire standing against a weathered, off-white brick wall featuring two distinct layers of distressed typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the structured, vintage-style upper text and the chaotic, hand-painted lower text.
Symmetry of the two subjects flanking the vertical center line.
Texture harmony between the distressed clothing, the rough brick, and the weathered paint effects.
coreInvariants: Distressed denim and layered accessories on subjects
Two-tier typographic hierarchy with contrasting styles

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two male subjects positioned centrally, full-body, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright blue graffiti-style text in the upper-middle section.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the blue text, move down to the subjects' faces, then follow their vertical stance to the floor.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant headroom above the subjects filled with large-scale typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Neutral off-white and beige tones from the brick wall.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and dark indigos from the subjects' clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant cerulean blue used for the graffiti-style lettering.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the dark clothing and light background; high saturation only in the blue accent.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Western slab-serif and expressive brush script
letterConstructionRules: Top tier: Ornate, Victorian-inspired slab serifs with internal decorative etching and drop shadows.
Bottom tier: Aggressive, gestural brush strokes with visible drips and uneven thickness.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial letters in the top tier are significantly larger and more ornate than the following characters.
Bottom tier letters feature splatters and paint runs extending downward.

composition.overlap: Overlays the brick and slightly touches the top text

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Historical formal vs. modern chaotic contrast.

preserve: The Victorian style of the top line

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the Victorian western slab-serif aesthetic for the top line.
Mimics the raw, dripping graffiti look of the second line.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A full-body shot of two men in distressed country-rock clothing standing against a weathered, off-white brick wall. The lighting should be bright and even, highlighting the textures of the brick and the denim.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a top line of ornate, Victorian-style slab-serif text with a weathered texture and drop shadow. Below it, apply a larger line of bright blue, hand-painted graffiti-style text with visible drips and splatters.

verificationChecks: Does the blue text look like wet paint?
Is the brick texture visible through the lettering?
Are the subjects centered and balanced?

adjustableVariables: Level of distress on the brick wall
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects

mustAchieve: Consistent lighting between subjects and wall

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the blue text is the most vibrant element.
Check that the Victorian text has a convincing 3D/etched quality.
Verify the clothing distress looks natural, not procedural.
Confirm the composition maintains a vertical central axis.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-texture urban background with a symmetrical duo portrait, then layer contrasting historical and chaotic typography using a single vibrant accent color.
